title: Tibetan alphabet, pronunciation and language
notable_features: Type of writing system: Abugida / Syllabic Alphabet. Each letter has an inherent vowel /a/. Other vowels can be indicated using a variety of diacritics which appear above or below the main letter.
Writing direction: left to right in horizontal lines.
Syllables are separated by a dot.
Consonant clusters are written with special conjunct letters.
